body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics announced the release of 'Galaxy Player', a smart player with Android platform followed by Galaxy S within January 2011.

'Galaxy Player' is new concept of 'smart player' which can install a variety of applications at Samsung Apps and Android market through Wi-Fi. OS is Android 2.2(Froyo), so the latest mobile service of Google is available.
The functionality of phone call is great. Wireless internet call and video call at Wi-Fi zone are possible.
Brighter and more vivid screen, video play without file conversion, DMB, virtual 5.1Ch surround sound, auto focus camera and GPS with free downloadable navigation program are features of it.
It's very portable thanks to the thickness of 9.9mm and the weight of 121g and battery is attachable.
Samsung is going to unveil Galaxy Player for the first time at CES 2011 held at Las Vegas, Nevada from Jan. 6-9 preparing a variety of marketing events.
Galaxy Player will be available for consumers within January, 2011.
